prompt:
Independently audit this contract against the indexed spec only.
Check (1) every spec segment mapped to a rule or marked unrelated/missing, (2) absent verbatim
evidence without uncertain, (3) contradictions between rule fields and examples, (4) plausible
alternative semantics with a concrete distinguishing chronological input sequence, and (5) derive
outputs for any explicit spec waveform/table/examples and compare. Report distinct material issues.
Return JSON {coverage:{Sxx:[rule IDs or "unrelated"/"missing"]},issues:[
{issue_id,rule_id (or "global"),type:"coverage"|"grounding"|"consistency"|"ambiguity"|"spec_example",
severity:"high"|"medium"|"low",detail,spec_evidence (verbatim spec or ""),alternative,sequence}]}.
Keep any deliberation brief and use short issue descriptions so the entire JSON fits. For ambiguity
the alternative must be specific; sequence must be a nonempty list of complete
width-valid nonclock input rows (optional mid) using the contract ports. For other types alternative
can be an empty string and sequence can be []. Code and prose outside JSON are not needed.
Indexed specification:
{"S01":"Implement a simple D flip flop with active high synchronous reset (reset output to 0)."}
Contract JSON:
{"ports":{"inputs":{"d":1,"r":1},"outputs":{"q":1},"clock":"clk"},"states":[{"name":"Q","meaning":"Stored flip-flop value, driven to q","update_time":"posedge clk","update_during_reset":true}],"rules":[{"id":"R1","outputs":["q"],"condition":"r == 1","edge":"posedge","visible":"same_cycle","priority":1,"spec_quote":"active high synchronous reset (reset output to 0)","uncertain":false,"example":{"vectors":[{"d":1,"r":1},{"d":0,"r":1},{"d":1,"r":0}],"expected":[{"q":0},{"q":0},{"q":1}]}},{"id":"R2","outputs":["q"],"condition":"r == 0","edge":"posedge","visible":"same_cycle","priority":2,"spec_quote":"Implement a simple D flip flop","uncertain":false,"example":{"vectors":[{"d":0,"r":0},{"d":1,"r":0},{"d":0,"r":0}],"expected":[{"q":0},{"q":1},{"q":0}]}}],"reset":{"kind":"sync","name":"r","active":"high","values":{"q":0},"first_released_cycle":"first posedge clk with r == 0"},"mid":"Optional mid input changes occur AFTER sampling, before the other edge, and are carried to the start of the next row.","uncertain":[]}
response: {"coverage":{"S01":["R1","R2"]},"issues":[{"issue_id":"I1","rule_id":"R2","type":"consistency","severity":"medium","detail":"R2 example expected q=0 on first r==0 posedge, but no prior state is defined; a DFF with d=0 would output 0 only if initial Q=0, which is unspecified.","spec_evidence":"Implement a simple D flip flop","alternative":"","sequence":[]},{"issue_id":"I2","rule_id":"global","type":"ambiguity","severity":"low","detail":"Initial state of Q before any posedge is unspecified; affects first-cycle output.","spec_evidence":"","alternative":"Q initializes to 0 at time 0","sequence":[{"d":1,"r":0}]},{"issue_id":"I3","rule_id":"global","type":"ambiguity","severity":"low","detail":"Alternative: Q initializes to 1 at time 0, distinguishing first-cycle output.","spec_evidence":"","alternative":"Q initializes to 1 at time 0","sequence":[{"d":0,"r":0}]}]}
